# Game-icons.net

`icons.json` is the full game-icons.net set (4,100+ icons) from the `@iconify-json/game-icons` npm package, version 1.2.4.

- Authors: Lorc, Delapouite and contributors (https://game-icons.net).
- License: CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/).

`generators/art.js` picks the icons for monsters, gods, demons and patrons. Only the icons it uses are shipped, in `site/data/art.js`. The site credits the authors on the About page.
